job: Title a working page and put its actions at the end of the row.
purpose: The compact title row: the title (the page's h1, at the h2 size), one line of description and the page's actions. Long unbroken titles wrap. data-size="sm" gives a 16px head for use inside a panel or a tool such as the parser.
useWhen: A working page, such as a table of runs or a tool, needs a title, a line and one or two actions.
A panel needs a small head with its own actions.

avoidWhen.when: A top-level screen opens with a tall band and an ASCII texture.
A title inside a card or dialog.
The title of a doc article with eyebrow and lead.

variants.useWhen: A 16px title inside a panel or a dense tool.

parts.role: One line saying what the page is for.
The actions at the end of the row.
